description: 'Retrieve taxon records from the Flora e Funga do Brasil database'
toc: true

```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::funga_records()
```

### Description

Retrieves and filters fungal taxon records from the locally parsed
[Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/)
taxonomic database, hosted by the [Rio de Janeiro
Botanical Garden](https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br). Unlike `funga_search`, which resolves a list of
species names you already have against the FFB database, `funga_records()`
browses and filters the FFB checklist itself by taxonomic, geographic, and
trait-based criteria; no input name list required.

### Details

The function downloads (if needed) and parses the FFB dataset exactly like
`funga_search`, then applies the requested filters:

- `taxon` is matched against the `family`, `genus`, and `taxonName` columns of the FFB taxon table (family names ending in `"aceae"`, single-word genus names, and multi-word species names are detected automatically).
- `taxonRank` and `taxonomicStatus` are matched directly against the taxon table.
- `state`, `phytogeographicDomain`, and `endemism` are matched against the FFB distribution table (`distribution.txt`).
- `lifeForm`, `habitat`, and `vegetationType` are matched against the FFB species profile table (`speciesprofile.txt`).

All filters are combined with a logical AND. The result always has one row
per matching taxon (geographic/trait filters restrict *which* taxa are
returned, they do not multiply rows).

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxon | Character vector. One or more family, genus, or species names to filter by (e.g. `c("Hymenochaetaceae", "Trichoderma", "Xylaria hypoxylon")`). `NULL` (default) does not filter by taxon. |
| taxonRank | Character vector. Taxonomic rank(s) to keep (e.g. `"ESPECIE"`, `"VARIEDADE"`, `"SUBESPECIE"`, `"FORMA"`, `"GENERO"`, `"ORDEM"`, `"DIVISAO"` - fungi are classified in FFB by Division/phylum rather than Class). `NULL` (default) keeps all ranks. |
| taxonomicStatus | Character vector. FFB taxonomic status to keep: `"NOME_ACEITO"` (accepted), `"SINONIMO"` (synonym), or `"NOME_DUVIDOSO"` (doubtful). `NULL` (default) keeps all statuses. |
| state | Character vector. Brazilian state(s) - full name or acronym, diacritics-insensitive (e.g. `"Bahia"` or `"BA"`) - to filter by occurrence, based on the FFB distribution table. `NULL` (default) does not filter by state. |
| phytogeographicDomain | Character vector. Phytogeographic domain(s) to filter by (e.g. `"Caatinga"`, `"Mata Atlantica"`). `NULL` (default) does not filter by domain. |
| endemism | Logical. If `TRUE`, keeps only taxa flagged as Brazilian endemics; if `FALSE`, keeps only non-endemics. `NULL` (default) does not filter by endemism. |
| lifeForm, habitat, vegetationType | Character vectors, based on the FFB species profile table. `NULL` (default) does not filter. - `lifeForm`: nutritional/ecological mode, e.g. `"Saprobio"`, `"Parasita"`, `"Liquenizado"`, `"Micorrizico"`, `"Endofitico"`, `"Entomogeno"`. - `habitat`: for fungi this field records the **substrate/host** the fungus was collected on rather than a plant growth habitat, e.g. `"Planta viva - raiz"`, `"Planta viva - folha"`, `"Planta viva - cortex do caule"`, `"Tronco em decomposicao"`, `"Folhedo"`, `"Solo"`, `"Esterco ou Fezes"`, `"Outro fungo"`, `"Animal morto"`. Use this argument to browse the checklist by host/substrate type (FFB does not currently publish a separate named host-taxon field). - `vegetationType`: vegetation type where the record was made, e.g. `"Floresta Ombrofila (= Floresta Pluvial)"`, `"Cerrado (lato sensu)"`, `"Manguezal"`. |
| version | Character. FFB dataset version to use. Defaults to `"latest"`. Passed to `funga_download` and `funga_parse`. |
| rm_funga_database | Logical. If `TRUE`, the downloaded FFB database folder (`"funga_download"`) is deleted after the search is complete. If `FALSE` (default), the database is kept on disk and reused by subsequent calls, which significantly speeds up repeated queries. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints informative progress messages during download and parsing. If `FALSE`, runs quietly. |
| save | Logical. If `TRUE`, the filtered records are saved to disk as a CSV file. Default is `FALSE`. |
| dir | Character. Directory where the CSV file will be saved when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"funga_records"`. |
| filename | Character. Name of the CSV file (without extension) to save when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"funga_records_search"`. |

### Value

A `data.frame` of FFB taxon records matching the requested
  filters, with one row per taxon, appended with the corresponding
  distribution and species-profile information for that taxon:
  `state`, `phytogeographicDomain`, `endemism`,
  `lifeForm`, `habitat`, and `vegetationType`. Since a
  single taxon can have several distribution/species-profile records
  (e.g. occurring in multiple states, or recorded on multiple
  substrates), each of these columns concatenates all distinct values
  for that taxon with `" | "` rather than multiplying rows. If
  `save = TRUE`, the result is also written to
  `<dir>/<filename>.csv`.

### Examples

```r
# All accepted species in Hymenochaetaceae (downloads + parses automatically, caches result)
hymeno <- funga_records(taxon = "Hymenochaetaceae",
                        taxonomicStatus = "NOME_ACEITO")

# Accepted species endemic to Bahia
bahia_endemics <- funga_records(state = "Bahia",
                                endemism = TRUE,
                                taxonomicStatus = "NOME_ACEITO")

# Lichenized fungi recorded in the Caatinga
caatinga_lichens <- funga_records(phytogeographicDomain = "Caatinga",
                                  lifeForm = "Liquenizado")

# Fungi recorded growing on living plant roots (habitat = substrate/host)
root_associates <- funga_records(habitat = "Planta viva - raiz")

# Use a specific FFB version stored in a custom folder, and save the result
funga_records(taxon = "Trichoderma",
             version = "393.418",
             save = TRUE,
             dir = "funga_records",
             filename = "trichoderma_records")
```
